description: go_copy_goroot only runs 'go env GOROOT', so its key doesn't identify the Go version; inferred (not traced) that darwin and Linux can share a key. Options: cell symlink goroot -> store path, or store path in copy_goroot argv. See docs/research/remote-execution-and-caching.md (commit adc3619d) §5.
title: Go toolchain: make GOROOT a keyed input instead of PATH (G2)
